info.description: Athena HTTP JSON APIs. API clients can authenticate protected operations with an Athena API Key by sending Authorization: Bearer <token>. The Athena server separately evaluates current account entitlements and any required module authorization for each protected request; this Swagger security declaration describes credential transport only and does not grant access.
info.title: Athena API

get.summary: ListAccounts returns the list of accounts
ListTokens lists API Key metadata for the current account.

put.summary: UpdateAccountAccess replaces a non-administrator account's access state.

parameters.description: access contains the complete supported account data module matrix.
parameters.name: body

put.summary: UpdateAccountProfile changes an account's public display name.

get.summary: GetAppBootstrap returns settings and the initial browser session state.

post.summary: ScanManagedOOBlock immediately scans one Polygon block for Managed OO logs.

get.summary: GetManagedOOStatus returns the Managed OO service runtime status.
ListMarketMovers returns price mover market rows.
GetMarketRadarStatus returns the Market Radar service runtime status.
Version returns version information of the API server

expiresIn.title: expiresIn represents a duration in seconds

binaryUrls.title: the URLs for downloading athena binaries

chatText.title: the text for getting chat help, defaults to "Chat now!"

chatUrl.title: the URL for getting chat help, this will typically be your Slack channel for support

name.title: the name of the plugin, e.g. "kasane"

kustomizeVersions.title:
Deprecated: use sidecar plugins instead.
repeated github.com.useryege.athena.pkg.apis.application.v1alpha1.ConfigManagementPlugin configManagementPlugins = 12;

managedooGetManagedOOStatusResponse.description: GetManagedOOStatusResponse returns the Managed OO service runtime status.

managedooListManagedOODisputesResponse.description: ListManagedOODisputesResponse returns dispute logs and pagination metadata.

managedooListManagedOOProposalsResponse.description: ListManagedOOProposalsResponse returns proposal logs and pagination metadata.

managedooScanManagedOOBlockResponse.description: ScanManagedOOBlockResponse returns decoded proposal and dispute counts for the block.

marketradarGetMarketRadarStatusResponse.description: GetMarketRadarStatusResponse returns the Market Radar service runtime status.

marketradarListMarketMoversResponse.description: ListMarketMoversResponse returns price mover market rows.

notificationNotificationRecoveryStatus.description: Recovery is observed by the sender process. Missing remaining evidence is not zero.

profitsharingRound.description: Round is the browser-facing flattened projection of a domain round.

versionVersionMessage.title: VersionMessage represents version of the Athena API server

count.description: Number of wallets to create. The accepted range is 1 through 10.

remark.description: A custom remark is accepted only when count is 1.
A custom remark is accepted only when exactly one private key is supplied.

privateKeys.description: Private keys are imported atomically in request order. The accepted size is 1 through 10.

wormtradingWormWalletSelectionSummary.description:
WormWalletSelectionSummary distinguishes an account that has not configured
Worm Trading from an explicitly configured empty selection. The selected
Wallet identities themselves remain available only through owner-scoped
balance/activity items and the interactive management resource.

athenaBearer.description: An Athena API Key supplied as Authorization: Bearer <token>. The account must have API Key access enabled and satisfy the server-side permission required by the operation.
athenaBearer.name: Authorization
